hero.newsText: Discover the new features of the VATBRZ platform to help our members fly and control with more immersion.
hero.subtitle1: Join the largest online aviation network,
hero.subtitle2: and interact with over 100,000 other virtual pilots
hero.subtitle3: and air traffic controllers all around the world.
hero.toolsText: Works seamlessly with all mainstream flight simulators on the market

features.subtitle: Seamless integration, live traffic, and support from a passionate community to elevate your simulation experience.
features.softwareText1: We are not here to be a pain in the back.
features.softwareText2: You choose what is best and we provide the tools.
features.communityText: Join our discord server and connect with thousands of aviation lovers.
features.liveText: See the amount of pilots flying and controllers online in the Brazilian airspace in real time.

resources.subtitle: Discover everything we have prepared for you to fly or control in the Brazilian airspace.
resources.textATC: Access manuals, training, and necessary software to start your journey as an Air Traffic Controller at VATBRZ.
resources.textPilot: Find routes, aeronautical charts, and exclusive guidelines to conduct your flights with maximum realism and immersion.

footer.disclaimer: VATBRZ is a division of VATSIM. This site is not affiliated with real world aviation.

branding.subtitle: Explore the official VATBRZ visual assets, colors, and guidelines.
branding.brandDesc: The VATBRZ brand was developed to represent the Brazilian division of VATSIM in official documents and announcements. The brand consists of the logo, representing the Southern Cross constellation and primary surveillance radar tracks, along with updated typography, bringing emphasis to BRZ and highlighting the Brazilian division of the network.

contact.subtitle: Need help or have a question? Contact us through our support channels.
contact.discordText: The fastest way to get support is through our Discord server. Join the community, open a ticket and our team will assist you as soon as possible.

staffPage.subtitle: Meet the volunteers who make VATBRZ happen. Our team dedicates their time and expertise to provide the best flight simulation and air traffic control.

faq.a1: VATSIM (Virtual Air Traffic Simulation Network) is a worldwide virtual aviation community. It operates the network to simulate real-world aviation traffic, allowing you to fly or control anywhere in the world.
faq.a2: A Virtual Airline or Special Operations organization is a group of members simulating specific flight operations together on the network.
faq.a3: VATBRZ is the Brazilian division of VATSIM, responsible for providing ATC services and virtual flight simulation in Brazilian airspace.
